title: Training Note — Order-Size Share of Storage Charges on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
Larger orders carry a lower order-size share of the storage charge on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** The order-size share depends on the order total billed on the order: at least 4 times the program's order minimum gives a share of 0.85; at least 2 times the order minimum but below 4 times it gives 0.95; otherwise the share is 1.

The storage charge is multiplied by the order-size share in the same product as the days of storage billed and the storage fee per day, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent and held to the storage cap; the share itself is never rounded.

## Questions answered by the clause

**Which total counts?** The order total billed on the order, read from its order billing line.

**Which order minimum?** The order minimum of the order's program.

## Marks for the deposit programs

| Program | Order minimum | Share 0.85 from | Share 0.95 from | Share 1 below |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 300.00 | 1200.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 1500.00 | 6000.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 800.00 | 3200.00 | 1600.00 | 1600.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** On a Windows and Exterior Doors order, 15 billable days at 5.00 a day give 63.75 for a billed total of 1200.00, 71.25 for 900.00 and 75.00 for 599.00.
